cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Consensus Means Me
cards.instruction: Treat every partial agreement as confirmation that everyone has accepted your leadership.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You nodded at Friday. Good, I'll tell the committee you've accepted my project leadership.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I agreed to the meeting date, not you being in charge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Following my timetable is a solid start. Choose when you'd like to speak; I want this leadership to work for everyone.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll attend, but I'll argue against your budget.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent, my finance watchdog. I'll put you before the vote and give you all the time you need. A leader knows the committee is behind them when the scrutiny is this willing.

reason: Have A give B actual speaking time for dissent while falsely treating limited date agreement and critical participation as acceptance of leadership.
